title: Persepolis Rising
author: James S. A. Corey
summary: The seventh Expanse novel jumps forward in time, to a solar system settled across many worlds. A strong new power from beyond the gates arrives with demands, and the old crew must decide how much to resist. Best read after the earlier books.
readIf: you already follow the Expanse and want to see its cast older and facing a new kind of enemy.
skipIf: you are new to the series, since it leans on years of history and relationships built in the earlier books.

pairings.reason: Politics of a vast empire and the pressure on smaller cultures, handled with a quieter, more diplomatic touch.
Another saga of rebellion across a settled solar system, harsher and more brutal.
The series opener, if you want to start where the crew first comes together.
